maria-docs: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to merge post-install networking and KMS tunnel examples for air-gapped installs. Need a short, copyable systemd example and a tcp-keepalive recommendation. 

samir-infra: Thanks. For airgap we usually recommend a persistent SSH tunnel with autossh; prefer systemd restart=always and a small keepalive. Example we use:

```
[Unit]
Description=autossh KMS tunnel
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=redwood
ExecStart=/usr/bin/autossh -M 0 -N -o "ServerAliveInterval=30" -o "ServerAliveCountMax=3" -L 6000:10.0.0.5:6000 kms-proxy.example.com
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

lee-onprem: FYI the local MTU can bite you with GRE/VXLAN overlays. Add note: if outer MTU < 1500, set --mtu 1400 for envoy and the tunnel. We had a customer hit fragmentation on 8k payloads.

ash-support: Also can we include a minimal conn-check snippet (curl + socat) and a troubleshooting bullet: "If handshake fails, check KMS SAN on the cert chain".

maria-docs: Good — I will add the autossh unit + MTU warning + conn-check. For the conn-check I was thinking:

```
# local port-forward test
socat TCP-LISTEN:6000,fork,reuseaddr TCP:127.0.0.1:6000 &
curl --silent --insecure https://127.0.0.1:6000/health
```

samir-infra: One more: include a short fallback policy if the KMS proxy becomes unavailable — sample config snippet pointing to a secondary KMS endpoint and a TTL-based cache. Something like:

```
kms:
  endpoints:
    - https://kms-primary.local:6000
    - https://kms-failover.local:6000
  cache_ttl: 60s
```

maria-docs: Adding that. Also found a broken anchor in the existing install guide to "post-install network checks" — I'll fix link and add an anchor id `#conn-checks`.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://internal.redwood/PRs/4012 — maria-docs requested reviewers: @samir-infra @lee-onprem :eyes:

lee-onprem: Quick nit — mention that HSM PKCS#11 modules often require setting LD_PRELOAD on RHEL kernels older than 5.15. Short line will save support tickets.

ash-support: +1. Also add a one-liner about sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_* defaults and recommend the autossh ServerAliveInterval tweak.

maria-docs: Will push updates by EOD. If anyone has a copyable oneliner for checking cert SANs quickly, paste here and I'll include. :thumbsup:

samir-infra: `openssl s_client -connect kms-proxy.example.com:6000 -showcerts | openssl x509 -noout -text | grep -A1 "Subject Alternative Name"`

maria-docs: Perfect — adding that. Thanks all, will merge once reviewers sign off.
